claude_proposed_widenings.name: apply_obscurement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Multiple table outcomes create persistent lightly or heavily obscured areas. The current surface has no effect atom for visibility-obscuring terrain or atmosphere, and v4 does not include one.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.rangeOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wand can cast existing spells with a forced maximum range of 120 feet when their normal range is shorter. The current spell-access override surface can change DC, area, target restriction, and duration, but not range.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.originOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Many branches cast an existing spell from the chosen point rather than from the wielder, and two branches orient a line from the wielder to that point. The current surface has no honest way to retarget a granted spell's origin to an arbitrary chosen point.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.target.selection.closest_to_point
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several branches target the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Existing target selection supports one, choose_up_to, and any_number, but not nearest-creature resolution from a remote point.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.uncontrolled
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: One branch summons a creature that is explicitly not under the user's control and simply acts normally until dismissal. The spawned-creature surface assumes some command interface exists.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.
